purpose: CMake build script for the native Notepad++ plugin DLL: compiles all C++ sources, links cmark-gfm and WebView2, and copies assets into the output directory.
invariants: Output is a DLL (SHARED library) named MarkdownPlusPlus
cmark-gfm is linked as a static library fetched via FetchContent
WebView2 SDK is consumed as a NuGet package via find_package
gotchas: Assets directory (CSS, JS, mermaid) must be in the same directory as the DLL at runtime; CMake post-build step handles copying
Build requires Visual Studio generator on Windows — Ninja/Unix Makefiles will not produce the correct DLL export decorations
